# braintrust_project (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust [project](https://www.braintrustdata.com/docs/guides/projects). Projects are the top-level organizational unit in Braintrust, containing experiments, datasets, prompts, and more.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project.

### Optional

- `baseline_experiment_id` (String) The ID of the experiment to use as the default baseline for comparisons.
- `comparison_key` (String) The key used to join two experiments (defaults to `input`).
- `description` (String) Textual description of the project.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of project creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of project deletion, or null if the project is still active.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the project (UUID).
- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier for the organization that the project belongs to.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the project.
